# CRH Health (Suzhou CRH New Material Technology)

> > China-based manufacturer and supplier of pharmaceutical packaging components including butyl rubber stoppers, isoprene gaskets, PP caps, infusion ports, and medical device closures.

Suzhou CRH New Material Technology Co Ltd specializes in producing high-quality medical and pharmaceutical packaging solutions, from rubber stoppers and gaskets to polypropylene caps and connecting ports for injection bottles, IV systems, and prefilled syringes. The company serves global healthcare markets with disposable medical supplies and pharmaceutical-grade components.

## Key Topics

- Butyl Rubber Stoppers
- Isoprene Gaskets
- Pharmaceutical Packaging
- PP (Polypropylene) Caps
- Medical Device Components
- Infusion Ports & Spike Ports
- Injection Bottle Closures
- Prefilled Syringe Components
- PTFE/ETFE Coated Stoppers
- IV Bottle Caps
- Pull-Ring Caps
- Flip Caps
- Medical Rubber Gaskets
- China Medical Manufacturer
- Disposable Medical Supplies
